title: Fate/stay night: Unlimited Blade Works
alt: A man with white hair in a red coat stands on a low hill with his back to us. He holds a short curved sword in each hand, one white and one black. Swords without number stand in a dry red plain round him, to a horizon that glows. Huge dark gear wheels hang in a red sky among bars of smoke.
summary: A painting of Archer in his Unlimited Blade Works from Fate/stay night in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Unlimited Blade Works, from Fate/stay night, a visual novel by Type-Moon. It is the world inside the hero Archer, made real round him: a dry plain, a sky of gears, and every sword that he has seen.
He stands with his back to us. The white sword in his right hand is Bakuya, and the black sword in his left hand is Kanshou. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
